indicators.methodology: Complement of the source's low-exposure estimate: about four-fifths of jobs in sub-Saharan Africa have limited exposure to AI
indicators.note: Regional only. The source publishes no country split.

indicators.indicator: Illustrative AI workload as a share of a monthly minimum wage
indicators.source: Computed from Claude Opus 5 (Anthropic) rate card and the statutory minimum wage
indicators.tier_label: Derived from academic and official inputs
indicators.methodology: A month of moderate use = 20 standard workloads at the median frontier rate card ($11.25 per workload), divided by the monthly statutory minimum wage.
